call connect
@ port baud=9600 data=8 parity=none stop=1 flow=none
> :MountInfo#
< 0045
> :GLS#
  -> Err(SdkError("The iOptron mount on <PORT> (model code 0045) did not answer the status query :GLS# (Operation timeout: iOptron command response timed out). Its firmware predates the 2016 command set Skotiq speaks: update the mount and hand controller firmware with iOptron's upgrade utility, then connect again."))
  connected=false
